reading.body:
This emerging and frontier category groups three humanoid or physical robotics products, Figure AI, Tesla Optimus, and Physical Intelligence's pi0, alongside autonomous software and web agents, Devin, Operator, and Anthropic's Computer Use, treating embodied robotics and autonomous digital agents as the same frontier category rather than separate fields.

Every entry in this category carries an explicit risk descriptor tied to autonomy or physical action: Devin is noted for full codebase access and being security critical, Operator for credential exposure and action authorization risk, and the three robotics entries for physical safety and worker interaction, a pattern distinct from the more governance dashboard focused notes seen in enterprise categories.

Mistral Large 2 is the one large language model in this otherwise agent and robotics heavy list, included here specifically for its EU hosted, GDPR first, sovereign AI positioning rather than for any autonomous capability, showing this category groups tools by how much unsupervised real world consequence they carry rather than by a single technical definition of frontier AI.

The data does not include deployment numbers, safety incident records, or benchmarked capability levels for any of these eight tools, so how far along toward real world autonomous deployment each one actually is is not established by this record.
